figurative_meaning_en: A woman with a restless mind and anxious heart
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চলচিত্ত চঞ্চরী, কোনো কাজে মন বসে না।
বাড়িতে চলচিত্ত চঞ্চরী হয়ে বসে থাকতে পারে না।
example_sentences_in_english: She is a restless and anxious woman, unable to focus on any task.
She can't sit still at home like a flibbertigibbet.
note: This idiom poetically describes feminine restlessness, rooted in traditional Bengali expressions.
